name: Pieter van der Merwe
bio:
Pieter's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through his passion for tinkering with engines on his family farm in the Free State. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, he joined a small racing team focused on domestic touring car series. His ability to diagnose and rectify performance issues quickly earned him a reputation for reliability. 

Pieter's strength lies in his practical approach to problem-solving. He prioritizes data-driven analysis and clear communication with drivers to optimize car setup. While not one to chase the latest trends, his deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and his steady hand have contributed to several championship wins over the years. He joined Manthey EMA seeking a new challenge in international GT racing, bringing his pragmatic and dependable engineering philosophy to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline.
